3.name: Dread Ambusher
3.notes:
You excel at fearsome ambush techniques.

Ambusher's Leap. At the start of your first turn in each combat, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

Dreadful Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you may deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage. You may use this effect once per turn and a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once). You regain all uses after a Long Rest.

Initiative Bonus. You add your Wisdom modifier to your Initiative rolls.

3.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed levels:

3rd: Disguise Self
5th: Rope Trick
9th: Fear
13th: Greater Invisibility
17th: Seeming

3.name: Umbral Sight
3.notes:
You gain Darkvision to 60 feet; if you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.

While entirely in Darkness, you are Invisible to creatures that rely on Darkvision to see in the Darkness.

7.name: Iron Mind
7.notes: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have it, choose to gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws instead.

11.name: Stalker's Flurry
11.notes:
Your Dreadful Strike damage becomes 2d8 Psychic damage.

Additionally, each time you use Dreadful Strike, choose one:

Sudden Strike. Make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target and within the weapon’s range.

Mass Fear. The target and all creatures within 10 feet of it make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failed save, affected creatures are Frightened until the start of your next turn.

15.name: Shadowy Dodge
15.notes: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the roll. Whether it hits or misses, you may then teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
